n: Science North Coding and Human Health lesson plan
t: A Grade 5 lesson where students code a micro:bit pedometer and pulse counter.
steps: Find the Coding and Human Health lesson plan on the Science North site and download it.
Gather computers and a class set of micro:bits.
Follow the teacher coding sheet for the pedometer.
Follow the BPM Coding Guide for the pulse counter.
Plan the experiments that record pulse and activity.
